VBO:0200128.summary: A Basset Hound–Poodle cross, the Bassoodle is also called a Bassetoodle. Documented matings include both Toy and Miniature Poodles.
VBO:0200128.shortDescription: A Basset Hound–Poodle cross, also called a Bassetoodle.
